description: This file defines the interface 'RequestResponseClient' in the org.eclipse.hono.client package, specifying methods for handling request-response communication patterns over AMQP, including closing links, checking connection status, and setting request timeouts.

classes.name: RequestResponseClient
classes.description: Interface for common methods that all AMQP request-response pattern clients need to implement, extending CreditBasedSender.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the AMQP link(s) with the Hono server without affecting the underlying connection. Invokes the provided handler with the result.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the client's sender and receiver links are (locally) open, indicating readiness for message exchange.

methods.name: setRequestTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout period for requests; requests exceeding this time are considered timed out and may lead to request failure.
